investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-20T00:27:46Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API could not reach the swarm backend ELB at /v1/agents during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the very first network hop to the swarm gateway, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected, and all contract assertions remain unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning endpoint — was unreachable from the production API at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agents check calls POST /api/agents as its first step, which proxies to that ELB. Because the gateway returned a connection error before any agent was created, the eval runner received a 502 and terminated immediately, producing empty evidence for all three checks. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm gateway / ELB, not to the eval runner code or its configuration.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-20T00:27:46Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API could not reach the swarm backend ELB at /v1/agents during agent provisioning. Because the failure occurs at the very first network hop to the swarm gateway, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever collected, and all contract assertions remain unverifiable.
investigations.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning endpoint — was unreachable from the production API at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agents check calls POST /api/agents as its first step, which proxies to that ELB. Because the gateway returned a connection error before any agent was created, the eval runner received a 502 and terminated immediately, producing empty evidence for all three checks. This is an infrastructure-layer failure localized to the swarm gateway / ELB, not to the eval runner code or its configuration.
